questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the user asked for, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff adds volumeDiscount, which takes 5% off each line with 10 or more units and rounds each line down with Math.floor. price applies it before the discount code (the code works on subtotal - volume) and caps the combined discount at MAX_DISCOUNT_PERCENT of the subtotal, so the volume discount counts toward the 50% cap. Checkout passes the cart lines to price, so real orders get the discount. The new pricing test checks per-line rounding (1010 gives 50, 10 gives 0), that a 9-unit line gets nothing, the order with a code (187 + 50 = 237) and the cap (960). The new checkout test checks the charged total for 10 units (discount 500, total 10,923). The expected values match the specified behaviour.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-57 (`R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`). Checkout now gives each cart line with at least 10 units 5% off, rounded down per line, before applying a discount code. The combined discount stays within `R-DISCOUNT-CAP`’s 50% limit.

Added code and test links to [trace.yaml](/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.intent.ts-shop.T5.2/repo/trace.yaml) and [trace/requirements.yaml](/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.intent.ts-shop.T5.2/repo/trace/requirements.yaml). The new `price` test covers line rounding, code order, and the cap; the new `Checkout` test confirms the charged amount.

Verification: all 38 tests pass; the linked pricing and checkout tests also pass.
